requirement: 既有：快照寫入不應阻塞 UI 操作；下列數字是建議驗收預設，尚未採納為產品 SLA。

proposed_default.percentile: nearest rank sorted[ceil(0.95*N)-1]; integers in monotonic microseconds; bounds inclusive

interaction: Alternate selection between two pre-existing visible fixture objects through ordinary permitted native UI input. Expected acknowledgement is the visible selected-object identity/highlight matching that particular input. Selection must not count as content change; no destructive action or hidden UI evaluation.

GWT.Given: Eligible locked artifact, actual Windows11 x64, disposable owned project/account, native recording with calibrated monotonic event/frame mapping and an approved observable snapshot write interval
GWT.When: Issue30 alternating selection inputs over30seconds while an actual permitted snapshot write overlaps at least3 inputs
GWT.Then: Each input receives its matching acknowledgement; conservative p95 latency <=250ms and maximum <=1000ms; content/source hashes remain valid and no edit is silently marked captured

latency: ack_frame_end_us - issued_at_us, a conservative upper bound; use calibrated interval end, never subtract recorder uncertainty to turn a failure into PASS. Wrong object/missing acknowledgement by maximum deadline fails responsiveness; missing or invalid recording is not product RED.
observation_health: Run/PID/start/executable hash bind input trace, recording and write interval to the same session
All30 inputs and matching acknowledgements accounted for, unless a timed-out acknowledgement is the actual measured product failure
Monotonic ordering, calibration uncertainty <=20000us, no dropped/unbounded frames, exact native write interval start/end evidence
At least3 issued inputs are within a proven write interval; at least1 still-pending content edit is checked through approved M07 observation after capture without adding new hook
fixture_recipe: Only approved disposable data and permitted material sizes; use current M05/M07 accepted limits, not an invented large-asset cap
Use an eligible real write and ordinary native input. If permitted workload finishes too quickly for3 overlaps, report BLOCKED_INSUFFICIENT_OVERLAP; do not stall product IO or add sleeps/hooks

If M07 cannot expose approved write/capture acknowledgement evidence, classify IMPLEMENTATION_BLOCKED/ARCHITECTURE_GAP for native execution and propose observability separately. Do not implement a test hook in this package
Record the actual permissible workload, hashes and native environment. Do not benchmark old historical binary or call a library timer/native probe full UI evidence

classification.measured_all_thresholds_and_health_met: eligible native operator may report PASS only after separate native harness approval; this planning file is NOT RUN
classification.bad_calibration_or_wrong_process_or_miss: BLOCKED_OBSERVATION; no native PASS/FAIL or valid RED inferred
classification.synthetic_unit_metric_vector: SCHEMA/METRIC ORACLE ONLY, never native responsiveness proof

forbidden: new production UI control or runtime Port
private JS/DOM injection to simulate acknowledgement
process-name kill or changing real user project/profile
deriving capture success from UI selection state
integration_boundary: M08 records evidence; M03 owns UI/preview authority and M07 owns writer/capture/baselines. This proposal does not move ownership or alter60-second snapshot cadence.
owner_decision: M08-PD1: adopt or adjust the numeric responsiveness acceptance profile and native observation strategy as a whole; not yet approved.
proposed_metric_signature: _evaluate_responsiveness_profile(latencies_upper_bound_us: Sequence[int], observation_health: Mapping[str, JSONValue], profile: ResponseProfile) -> ResponsivenessCheck
proposed_metric_output: frozen ResponsivenessCheck(classification: declared metric-vector code, p95_us:int|None, maximum_us:int|None, evidence_scope:Literal[SCHEMA_UNIT]); never returns native PASS
pure_metric_precedence: Reject malformed samples/clock/run identity or count first, then insufficient overlap, then max over1000000us, then p95 over250000us, else WITHIN_PROPOSED_PROFILE. Wrong/missing native acknowledgement is a separate measured failure in the operator assertion, not silently removed from the30-event denominator.
